title: tilia americana f. fastigiata
intro: Tilia americana f. fastigiata, commonly known as the American Linden Fastigiate or Tall American Linden, is a cultivar of the American Linden tree (Tilia americana). It is a deciduous tree valued for its ornamental beauty and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Tilia americana f. fastigiata include its ability to alleviate anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its sedative and calming effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects.
